core_obligations: Reduce to checking the G-ring, J-2 and universal catenarity conditions for the listed classes (proof lines 13398-13399).
Get the first two from the ubiquity propositions (proof lines 13398-13399).
Get universal catenarity for fields, Dedekind rings and regular rings from the Cohen-Macaulay case (proof lines 13400-13402).
Handle complete local rings via the Cohen structure theorem (proof lines 13403-13407).
proof_roadmap: G-ring and J-2 from the ubiquity propositions (proof lines 13398-13399).
Universal catenarity via Cohen-Macaulay rings (proof lines 13400-13402).
Complete local rings via the structure theorem (proof lines 13403-13407).
difficulty_reason: The proposition records that five classes of rings are excellent. Excellence combines the G-ring condition, the J-2 condition and universal catenarity, and the proof assembles the three ingredients for each class: the first two come from the two ubiquity propositions for G-rings and for J-2, and universal catenarity is obtained from the fact that Cohen-Macaulay rings are universally catenary, which covers fields, Dedekind rings and more generally regular rings, while complete local rings are handled through the Cohen structure theorem.
